Market today: Mixed signals. The Fed's hint at holding rates steady is a positive for your growth-heavy tech book, but rising China risks in AI data centers and Broadcom's stock fall point to sector-specific headwinds for chips. Oil prices are also up due to Mideast tensions.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.14%) and SPAL (-31.69%) are leveraged ETFs with significant losses and need immediate attention. SMH (-14.38%) and QQQI (-3.62%) are at TRIM status and very close to their stops, which margin amplifies.

Watch: Keep an eye on Fed commentary for any shifts in rate policy and monitor geopolitical developments in the Mideast for broader market impact. Also, watch for further news on AI data center risks.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged and near-stop positions; risk management is key with your margin exposure.
plays: SOXL: With a -60.14% loss and "SELL" status, seriously consider reducing this highly leveraged position to mitigate further decay and capital erosion.
SMH & QQQI: Respect your stops at 540 and 52 respectively. If breached, trim these positions as indicated by your scanner.
GUSH: Given rising oil prices and a "BUY" scanner setup (entry 46.75-46.65, stop 46.11), this could be a diversifying play to consider.
